notes: Small MVP set for the UTP CodeFest final, not the full MASCO 2020 or ESCO download.

Occupation codes and Malay titles were checked against eMASCO (emasco.mohr.gov.my) search listings on 11 Nov 2026; the eMASCO pages themselves block automated reading, so task texts are marked per task.

ESCO: preferred labels are given as the team understands them; no ESCO URI could be checked from the build sandbox, so every esco_uri is null with esco_uri_status 'unverified'. Fill them from the ESCO v1.2 download before the pilot.
Skill keys (careerprep:skill/...) are the stable primary keys. ESCO URIs are stored beside them so a later ESCO update never breaks a student's progress rows.
